4	
5	# App Style Guide — Kanban / MD² (React + MUI)
6	
7	How to build **any new component** so it matches the app. This is written for **Material UI v5+** components.
8	
9	**The theme is the source of truth.** All color, radius, base typography, and spacing units live in the single `createTheme` (defined in `GUIDANCE.md` §1/§9). This guide does **not** define colors — it tells you **which theme value to use for which role**, and covers the things the theme can't encode: layout, spacing/margins, borders, elevation, and component conventions.
10	
11	**The one rule that matters:** never write a raw hex, px radius, or magic color into a component. Read it from the theme (`theme.palette.*`, `theme.shape`, `theme.typography`, `theme.spacing`). If a component has a hardcoded hex in its `sx`/styled, it's wrong — that's exactly where the look drifts and where dark mode breaks.
12	
13	---
14	
15	## 1. How to consume the theme
16	
17	- **Colors:** `sx={{ color: 'text.secondary', bgcolor: 'background.paper', borderColor: 'divider' }}` — MUI resolves dotted palette paths automatically in `sx`. In `styled`/JS use the callback form: `styled(Box)(({ theme }) => ({ color: theme.palette.text.secondary }))`.
18	- **Spacing:** use the 8px unit via the spacing scale — `sx={{ p: 2, gap: 1, mt: 1.5 }}` (`2` = 16px, `1` = 8px). Don't write `padding: '16px'`.
19	- **Radius:** `borderRadius: 1` (= `theme.shape.borderRadius` = 8) and multiples; for the fixed non-8 radii see §4.
20	- **Typography:** prefer `Typography variant=...` and `theme.typography.*` over ad-hoc `fontSize`.
21	- **Custom tokens:** roles the default MUI palette doesn't cover (column/track surfaces, the strong/hover border steps, `text-3/4`, section-header color, `primary-bg` tint, status colors) must exist in the theme under a namespace (e.g. `theme.palette.custom.*`) with light + dark values. Consume them the same way — `bgcolor: 'custom.column'`. **Never inline their hex.** If a needed token doesn't exist yet, add it to the theme, don't hardcode it in the component.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## 2. Role → theme slot
26	
27	Pick the slot by the element's **role**, not by how it looks in one mode:
28	
29	| Role | Theme slot |
30	|---|---|
31	| App background; tinted footer/action bars | `background.default` |
32	| Column & sidebar surface | `custom.column` |
33	| Segmented-control / toolbar track, hover fill | `custom.track` |
34	| Card, dialog, popup, input surface | `background.paper` |
35	| Hairlines, resting borders | `divider` |
36	| Input borders, vertical separators | `custom.borderStrong` |
37	| Border on hover | `custom.borderHover` |
38	| Titles, values, headings | `text.primary` |
39	| Body copy, field labels | `text.secondary` |
40	| Meta, captions, resting icons | `custom.text3` |
41	| Muted / placeholder / disabled | `custom.text4` |
42	| Uppercase section/column headers | `custom.colHead` |
43	| The one CTA, selection, focus, links, icon-hover | `primary.main` |
44	| Contained-button hover | `primary.dark` |
45	| Selected/tinted bg, focus ring, ID-chip bg | `custom.primaryBg` |
46	| Text/icon on a primary fill | `primary.contrastText` |
47	| Active / saved / online dot | `success.main` |
48	| Destructive action | `error.main` |
49	| Status swatch dots & ID-chip tints (decorative only) | `custom.status.*` |
50	
51	Rules: **one** `primary` per surface (the CTA/selection accent) — everything else is `text-*`/`divider`. Status colors are **decoration only** (dots, chip tints), never interactive color. Dark-mode brightness/tinting is handled inside the theme's two palettes, so a correctly-sloted component needs zero per-mode code.
52	
53	---
54	
55	## 3. Layout
56	
57	- **Full-height app:** column flex — menu row / ribbon / content (`flex: 1; minHeight: 0`) / status bar. Fixed bands `flexShrink: 0`.
58	- **Board:** horizontal-scroll flex row, `gap: 2` (16px), page padding `p: 2.5` (20px); columns `width: 296, flexShrink: 0`, internal column flex `gap: 1`.
59	- **List view:** two-pane flex row filling t
[4077 characters omitted]
gerBg`.
104	- **Contained (primary) CTA:** `primary.main` + small shadow → hover `primary.dark`.
105	- **Input/field focus:** `borderColor: primary.main` + `boxShadow: 0 0 0 3px` in `custom.primaryBg` (the soft halo). Unfocused hover: `borderColor: custom.borderHover`.
106	- **List/tree row:** hover `bgcolor: track`; selected `bgcolor: custom.primaryBg` + title `text.primary`.
107	- **Row-level actions** (delete, ⋮): hidden at rest, shown on `:hover`/`:focus-within` via **opacity** (keep in DOM so width doesn't jump).
108	- **Active tab/menu item:** 2px `primary.main` bottom border + `primary.main` text.
109	- Every icon-only control gets a `Tooltip` (theme sets `arrow: true`) **and** an `aria-label`.
110	
111	---
112	
113	## 8. Component conventions (MUI primitives)
114	
115	- **Buttons:** `Button variant="contained"` = the single CTA per surface; `variant="outlined"` = secondary; `variant="text"` = tertiary. Icon-only → `IconButton` in a `Tooltip`. Don't use `Link` or text `Button` where an action button belongs (that reproduces the old text-link look).
116	- **Icons:** `@mui/icons-material` **Outlined** variants; `fontSize: 18` in 34px buttons, `16` in dense, `13–15` inline. Don't hand-draw SVG.
117	- **ID chip:** monospace, accent text on `custom.primaryBg`/status tint, `radius 5, flexShrink: 0`.
118	- **Count chip:** `background.paper` bg, 1px `divider`, radius 9–10, `custom.text3`.
119	- **State dot:** 7–8px circle + `text-3` label; green (`success.main`) = active/saved/online.
120	- **Search:** pill `TextField` (`borderRadius: 99`, `bgcolor: background.default`), search start-adornment, `⌘K` keycap end-adornment.
121	- **Select:** `size="small"`, optional dot+name via `renderValue`; 42px / radius-9 frame. When a select has a tooltip, keep the tooltip available while the select is closed and explicitly hide it for the entire time the select menu is open so it cannot cover the first option.
122	- **Menu / context menu:** all `Menu` / `MenuItem` dropdowns and right-click context menus are dense by default through the theme. Call sites must not set density; `Select` option lists inherit the same density.
123	- **Segmented control** (view switch, formatting toolbar): `ToggleButtonGroup` on a `custom.track` background; selected segment `background.paper` + `0 1px 2px` shadow + `primary` text.
124	- **Dialog / popup:** `Dialog`/`Popover` with `PaperProps` → `background.paper`, 1px `divider`, radius 14, big shadow; scrim via `slotProps.backdrop` (blur + tint). Bands separated by hairlines; footer on a `background.default` bar with top hairline; actions right-aligned (outlined Cancel + contained CTA). `autoFocus` first field; submit on `Enter` (`⌘/Ctrl+Enter` in a textarea); close on `Esc`/backdrop — except that a dialog holding unsaved multi-field input may refuse `backdropClick` (return early from `onClose(event, reason)`) so a stray click on the scrim cannot discard typed values; `Esc` and the Cancel button must still close it, and Cancel stays visible and enabled, including while loading.
125	- **Empty state:** dashed target — `1.5px dashed custom.borderStrong`, radius 10, centered icon + `custom.text4` label. No "click to add" placeholder blocks.
126	
127	---
128	
129	## 9. Definition of done for a new component
130	
131	1. Zero hardcoded hex / raw px colors — every value comes from `theme.palette` / `theme.shape` / `theme.spacing` / `theme.typography`.
132	2. Correct role→slot mapping (§2); at most one `primary` CTA on the surface.
133	3. Borders at rest, shadow only when floating (§5); bands split by a single hairline.
134	4. Hover **and** focus states on every interactive element (§7); icon buttons have tooltip + `aria-label`.
135	5. Body scrolls, header/footer pinned; `minWidth: 0` on flex children that hold long text.
136	6. Toggle to dark mode and confirm nothing breaks — if it does, you hardcoded a color somewhere (§1).
137	
138	Component-specific detail lives in `GUIDANCE.md` (theme definition + board/list/dialog), `CARD_POPUP_GUIDE.md`, `RUN_DIALOG_GUIDE.md`, and `SIDEBAR_ACTIONS_GUIDE.md`.

entries.content: Analysis done. Creating one task per block now. No code edits until approval.

Plan ready, five tasks created, no files changed. F_471 has no Test Plan or Acceptance Criteria section, so I treat its four bullets as scope and do nothing beyond them.

**Blocks**

1. **Popup frame and title** (`json_data_popup.tsx`). Popup has no shadow today because theme sets paper elevation to 0. Popup gets same frame as card popup: paper background, 1px divider border, 14px radius, `0 24px 60px` shadow. Header band and title take card padding and bold 16px type.
2. **Drop inner card** (`json_data_editor.tsx`). Padded wrapper and outlined `Card` go away, so content runs edge to edge under header. Both hosts of this component, popup and list-view tab, get new look. Nothing needs old look.
3. **Icon footer bar** (new `json_array_actions_footer.tsx`).
   - Component receives only `document`, subscribes itself, and takes over Add, Delete, Copy, Cut, Paste handlers from `JsonArrayEditor`.
   - Bar copies card footer: `background.default` fill, top hairline, pinned below table.
   - Buttons become Outlined-icon `IconButton`s with tooltip and `aria-label`. Delete uses error color, as on card.
   - Tooltip wraps a `span`, because disabled buttons fire no hover events and tooltip would never show.
   - Actions sit left, so popup's bottom-right resize corner stays clear.
4. **Tests** (new footer test file, `json_data_editor.test.tsx`).
   - Footer test covers icon-only named buttons, disabled states for empty selection and read-only documents, and clipboard error reporting through `dialogService`.
   - Editor test asserts objects and scalars show no footer, and stale "in a card" test name gets renamed.
   - Frame styling gets no test, because AGENTS.md rejects tests that assert visual values.
   - I run only related tests, typecheck and lint.
5. **Status.** After implementation, F_471 `status` becomes `ready`.

**Decisions for you**

- **Title text:** spec only says "title". I recommend keeping full file path, restyled as card title, ellipsized when long. Alternative is file name only, but breadcrumb directly below already shows file name.
- **Footer on objects and scalars:** I recommend array views only, because objects and scalars have no list actions and bar would sit empty. Cost: popup height for content differs slightly between array and object views.
- **Footer Close button:** card footer has contained Close button, spec does not ask for one. I recommend leaving it out and keeping header X.

Approve with those defaults, or tell me what to change. Separately, caveman plugin offers status-line badge showing active mode. Say so if you want it set up.

Source is correct, no code change needed. Your running app holds a stale, half-edited copy of `json_array_editor.tsx`.

- **Cause:** I made several edits to that file in a row. The first one added the footer to the markup, and the import came a few edits later. The dev server's hot reload picked up the in-between version, which used `JsonArrayActionsFooter` before importing it.
- **Evidence:** your error points at line 173. That matches the in-between version exactly. The current file uses the footer at line 172 and imports it at line 9. Tests, typecheck and lint all ran against the finished file and passed.
- **Fix:** reload the app window (Ctrl+R) so it loads the current file. If the error persists after a reload, restart the dev server.
